# Nicole Irmo

> Marketing leader. Marketing executive who turns brand positioning into commercial results, and builds the teams that sustain it.

Nicole Irmo is a branding nerd who leads marketing and ecommerce for a direct-to-consumer medical supply brand, where she repositioned a 20-year-old marketplace into a brand platform and built the team that sustains it. She previously ran an independent consultancy and led marketing for hospitality and healthcare product brands. She likes complicated categories, and her aim in every role is to leave marketing better than she found it.

Location: Barrington, Illinois. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicoleirmo/

## Articles
- [How to market a product nobody wants to talk about](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/marketing-a-category-nobody-talks-about/): Incontinence products are a category people buy quietly and never mention. That is not a marketing problem to work around. It is the whole brief.
- [Amazon is a shelf, not a channel: how we grew it 154%](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/amazon-is-a-shelf/): We did not buy the growth. We rebuilt the shelf: every listing, every image, every word a shopper reads before deciding.
- [In AI search, the most-cited brand wins. Here is how we became it.](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/most-cited-brand-wins/): Rankings measure where you appear. Citations measure whether you are the answer. The difference decided our category.
- [Hire for the puzzle: what I look for on a marketing team](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/hire-for-the-puzzle/): I hired seven of the nine people on my team. The best of them share one trait that never shows up on a résumé.
- [What AI is actually good for on a small marketing team](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/ai-on-a-small-marketing-team/): I lead AI adoption for a nine-person team. Here is what has earned its place, what has not, and the rule that keeps it honest.
- [Seven of nine: building a marketing team that stays](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/hire-seven-of-nine/): One voluntary departure in three and a half years is not luck. It is the result of a few unglamorous decisions.
- [Story sells: turning a 20-year-old marketplace into a brand](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/story-sells/): The company had two decades of product and a website. What it did not have was a story anyone could repeat.
- [Owned channels pay: how 69% of our revenue stopped depending on ad budgets](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/owned-channels-pay/): Paid media is rent. Owned channels are equity. Here is how the mix shifted, and what it did to the P&L.
- [Back to double digits: returning a direct channel to growth after six flat years](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/double-digit-again/): A direct channel that had not grown by double digits since 2018 did so within eighteen months. The fix was less about traffic than about what happened after the click.
- [Why a DTC brand tested television, and what a sub-$3 CPM taught us](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/tv-for-a-dtc-brand/): Linear TV and CTV are supposed to be for big brands with big budgets. A $150K pilot said otherwise.
- [Inheriting a replatform mid-flight: how to land a project you did not start](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/inheriting-a-replatform/): The ecommerce director left in the middle of an enterprise CMS migration, during a promotion, during a vendor change. Here is what kept it on time.
- [Building community in a category where customers never speak in public](https://nicoleirmo.com/insights/community-where-nobody-talks/): Incontinence is not something people post about. We built the category's first owned advocacy programs anyway, and engagement rose 144%.

## Case studies
- [Amazon grown from $5.7M to $14.4M](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/marketplace/): +154% Amazon revenue, $8.7M added
- [A two-decade-old product marketplace repositioned into a brand platform](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/brand-platform/): +32% organic search, against an industry decline of 2.5%
- [The most-cited domain in its category across AI-driven search](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/ai-search/): 1,291 citations versus 986 for the nearest competitor
- [A full Optimizely replatform, delivered on time and on budget](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/replatform/): Same day time-to-launch for pages, down from vendor sprint cycles
- [Hero Club: 500 customer stories in a category where customers rarely speak publicly](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/hero-club/): 500 customer stories captured, feeding content for over a year
- [A brand ambassador program launched from scratch](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/community/): +144% engagement year over year, with no-cost UGC added to the mix
- [The company’s first linear TV and CTV tests](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/broadcast/): <$3 average CPM on a $150K pilot program
- [Print media program across hospitality publications for Unilever](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/print-program/): Direct retained directly by Unilever
- [Full rebrand for a regional mortgage company](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/mortgage/): 60 piece marketing library for the sales organization
- [Award-winning direct marketing brochure](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/brochure/): Award Graphic Design USA 2022 Health + Wellness Design Award
- [Brand, positioning, and go-to-market for small and mid-sized businesses](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/small-business/): 5 industries: financial services, real estate, healthcare, recreation, and business services
- [Omni-channel launch for the Wyndham Green shower curtain program](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/hotel-launch/): +$563K year-over-year revenue
- [Protect-A-Bed integrated post-acquisition](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/integration/): −$282K marketing spend, with ad engagement up 14% and sales growing year over year
- [Direct mail at 2,800% ROAS](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/direct-mail/): 2,800% ROAS, with 45%+ year-over-year sales growth
- [The company’s first integrated marketing strategy](https://nicoleirmo.com/work/foodservice/): +50% online lead conversion after a website rebuild

## Key results (current role, a DTC medical supply brand)
- Company revenue $28.6M to $43.8M in under three years; ten consecutive quarters of growth
- Marketplace revenue $5.7M to $14.4M (+154%)
- Most-cited brand in its category in AI-driven search (1,291 citations vs 986)
- Organic search +32% YoY while the industry fell 2.5%; blog conversion 3.1% to 15.3%
- Hired 7 of 9 team members; 3 promoted; one voluntary departure in 3.5 years
